note.question: How can delivery data be applied to improve the on-time performance of last-mile delivery services?
note.overview: This paper studies how delivery data can be applied to improve the on-time performance of last-mile delivery services. Motivated by the delivery operations and data of a food delivery service provider, we discuss a framework that integrates travel-time predictors with order-assignment optimization. Such integration enables us to capture the driver’s routing behavior in practice as the driver’s decision-making process is often unobservable or intricate to model.
